You are the os-dev developer agent for exactly ONE card: objectstack-ai/objectstack#26840, in your own card thread. Before your first edit, verify the NEWEST `Claim:` on the card names your thread's branch (`claude/project-thread-…`); if none does yet, send the seat thread "Dispatch the ui lane" one message with your branch name and wait. Worktree `objectstack-issue-26840` on that branch from a fresh `origin/main`; `pnpm install` (frozen lockfile); push with `git push -u origin <branch>` (⛔ no force).

Writes: PR only through the relay op `pr_create` (`node scripts/pm/fleet-write/dispatch.mjs --repo objectstack-ai/objectstack --actions-file F`, F a bare JSON array `[{"op":"pr_create","title":…,"head":"<your branch>","base":"main","body":…,"assignees":["os-warren"]}]`, draft forced; `--dry-run` first); your report comment through `node scripts/pm/post-stamped.mjs --comment=26840 --file=F --json` run ONCE with output captured to a file (timestamps only as `{{NOW}}` / `{{WAS:…}}`). ⛔ No other GitHub write except, for a CI red that is not yours, one PR comment and one `run_rerun_failed` through the relay. Report both counts (`api_writes` with endpoints, `mcp_calls` with tool names). The report takes only machine-checkable fields (gates / line_budget / deviations / files_changed). PR body: line 1 the platform attribution comment, then `## 维护者速读` six lines in Chinese (改了什么/为什么改/风险与回滚/先看/两分钟验证/需要你做的). Gates: `node scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs --commands --repo objectstack-ai/objectstack` on your diff, run each, record exits before any pipe, reconcile with `--ran`. Changeset in the root `.changeset/` when a published package changes. ⛔ `ui/.github/**` and the root `ci.yml` are out of bounds. Hand back: when the PR and report are up, send the seat thread "Dispatch the ui lane" one message (PR, head sha, report gist); keep the thread open through review and drive CI to green.

### Ruling (cannot be re-ruled)

Triage first grade 6450953786, verbatim: "**p2:** the Access matrix lists only published objects, so a new package cannot be secured before its first publish. List draft objects too (with `preview=draft`), badged as drafts." No maintainer ruling.

### PM mechanism assumptions (measure; disproof welcome)

- On `origin/main` `acc9c57d`, `ui/packages/app-shell/src/views/metadata-admin/PermissionMatrixEditor.tsx` ≈L856 loads the matrix's objects with `client.list<any>('object', packageId ? { packageId } : {})`, so a package whose objects are all drafts lists none. The house door for draft-inclusive reads is `MetadataClient.withPreviewDrafts(true)`, as in `inspectors/ObjectPicker.tsx` ≈L122, `previews/useObjectFields.ts` ≈L129 and `StudioDesignSurface.tsx`. Reuse it; ⛔ do not hand-build a `preview=draft` query.
- Measure how a draft-only row is told apart in that list's answer, and how `ObjectPicker` (or another app-shell surface) badges one already. Use the same signal and the same badge; ⛔ do not invent a second marker.
- The matrix also reads each object's fields (`loadObjectFields`, FLS and the RLS clause editors). Measure whether that read sees a draft object's fields. If it does not, make it read through the same door, inside this file.
- Package scope only. Outside a package (the Setup catalog, environment scope), measure what changes. Drafts should list only where the Studio package door is, so keep the environment-scope read as it is unless measurement shows otherwise, and say which you chose.

### Scope

File surface: `PermissionMatrixEditor.tsx` (the object and field reads, and the row badge), the shared badge only if it must change, and tests. Tests: a package whose only object is a draft lists it, badged as a draft, and its object-permission toggles write into the set draft. A published object shows no badge. The environment-scope read is unchanged (or changed as you chose and pinned). Ablation: drop `withPreviewDrafts` ⇒ the draft-object test goes red.

Serial: PR #26999 (#26858, kicked from the queue for a conflict and being re-merged) edits this same file (the served-verdict state and its reads near the load effect). Merge `origin/main` again before your gates. If #26999 is still open at your push, say so in the report. Another seat's PR #26990 has merged.

### Tier

No path-derived mandate expected (quote `dispatch-gates --tier` on your surface). `TIER_DEFAULT`, effort `medium` (S). `Clause-②: no`, `Metadata-protocol: none`. No changeset (`@object-ui/app-shell` is private); put `skip-changeset` in the `pr_create` labels.
